findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:11-26 (`# DIS Kinematics Access Methods` — "This module implements reconstruction methods for DIS invariants from experimental measurements", with `ElectronMethodData` l.50 and `SigmaMethodData.ySigma` l.119); roadmap README.md:196-200 names `Kinematics.AccessMethods` as carrying "the reconstruction of the invariants from measured momenta". The moved declarations' signatures (`def electronMethod (g : Bilin V) (k p kPrime : V)`, Radiative.lean:135) mention no radiative type.
findings.fix: Move `ReconstructedInvariants`, the four method definitions and `electronMethod_disKinematics` into `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Kinematics/AccessMethods.lean`; keep `TrueInvariants`, `TrueInvariants.toReconstructed`, `EmissionLine`, `RadiativeEvent` and all shift theorems in `Radiative.lean`, which already imports AccessMethods.
findings.issue: `ReconstructedInvariants` (l.89), `electronMethod` (l.135), `hadronicMethod` (l.144), `sigmaMethod` (l.155), `mixedMethod` (l.163) and `electronMethod_disKinematics` (l.170) contain no radiative content: they depend only on `Bilin`/`DisKinematics` (Kinematics/Basic) and `SigmaMethodData.ySigma` (Kinematics/AccessMethods), not on `RadiativeEvent` or `EmissionLine`. Their canonical home is the earlier `Kinematics/AccessMethods.lean`, whose stated topic is exactly DIS reconstruction methods and which already hosts the electron and Sigma methods in their frame-specific form; keeping them in `Radiative.lean` splits one reconstruction API across two modules and forces anything method-level (e.g. the planned `*_lab_formula` lemmas of roadmap 1.2) to import a radiative-events file.

summary: The file is in the right directory and its single import is used and appropriately narrow, but the non-radiative covariant reconstruction methods belong in the earlier Kinematics/AccessMethods.lean, which is already the canonical home of DIS reconstruction methods.
